interpretation: This packet recommends closing USA discovery and freezing25 research priorities. It does not change published counters, assert100 independent new audits, count old SF reports as new USA alpha, or endorse donations. Root must integrate acceptance and selection into ledger.
decisionMethod: Retain all98 discovery acceptances regardless of selection economics. Replace only actual sponsor-scope held memberships. Rank is research order, not measured cost-effectiveness; no numeric QALY forecast or forced mechanism quota.

replacements.mechanism: Equip likely overdose witnesses with naloxone and response training, with targeted community distribution.
replacements.highEvHypothesis: An additional effective rescue among high-risk people could avert severe immediate harm; donated medication and community channels may make this a promising unrestricted-dollar research priority.
replacements.keyFalsifier: Kits and training may reach low-risk people, substitute publicly supplied naloxone, remain unused or arrive too late. Distribution and reported reversals cannot be treated as incremental deaths averted; survivor follow-up and competing mortality matter.

replacements.mechanism: Technology, logistics and policy facilitate safe surplus-medicine redistribution to underserved patients through dispensing partners.
replacements.highEvHypothesis: Recovering usable medicine and connecting it to people who would otherwise miss effective chronic therapy could yield sustained health benefits with low acquisition cost and scalable logistics.
replacements.keyFalsifier: Reject the health-leverage hypothesis if medicines mainly replace purchases or other aid, do not match clinical need, are not taken consistently, or have insufficient remaining shelf life. replacements.wholeOrganizationGiftScope: Evaluate unrestricted SIRUM's full collection, matching, technology, policy and partner support, plus the financial relationship to Good Pill and dispensing partners. Include patient fees and partner costs; do not count all partner clinical output as SIRUM-caused or use only best-condition medicines.

all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Defer: important elder protections span housing, income and care; clinical access increment is less focused than selected care-law candidate.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Need care-quality/health outcomes, not merely restored benefits; legal contribution and baseline care matter.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: Include housing, income security, elder rights and all advocacy costs in whole-org assessment.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: Medicare Rights Center
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Defer: counseling may unlock benefits but free public alternatives and additional treatment uncertainty lower priority.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Substitution for free SHIP/insurer counseling and benefit receipt without treatment changes may sharply reduce effect.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: Whole-org counseling, education and policy; do not credit all Medicare benefits or only successful clients.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: National Consumer Law Center
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Defer: consumer/debt improvements are largely nonhealth outcomes; stronger direct health pathways exist in this pool.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Health linkage is indirect; broad debt/credit improvements may produce limited measured health benefit.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: Most work concerns consumer/economic rights; whole-org health share and additional litigation influence need scrutiny.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: Center for Science in the Public Interest
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Prioritize population food standards and reformulation potential; implementation and dietary substitution must survive scrutiny.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Policy implementation, diet substitution, industry adaptation and actual morbidity changes must be established.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: Include all advocacy, publishing and education; do not reuse historic reform wins as current marginal impact.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: Action on Smoking and Health
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Defer: tobacco mechanism strong but worldwide and broad endgame portfolio less clearly tied to marginal domestic gifts.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Need feasible policy change and attributable smoking reduction; product substitution and overseas dilution matter.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: US ASH recipient only, not similarly named UK organization; entire global/domestic portfolio affects unrestricted gift.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: American Nonsmokers' Rights Foundation
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Prioritize charitable smoke-free implementation resources with focused US exposure pathway; exclude lobbying affiliate output.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Remaining policy opportunities may be difficult; historical national trends are not charity-attributable effects.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: Foundation c3 only; do not combine separately funded Americans for Nonsmokers Rights lobbying arm.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: Truth Initiative
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Defer: cessation evidence may be promising but investment assets, earned partnerships and campaign mix create a large funding-additionality question.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Need current program causal cessation, relapse and smoking-versus-vaping substitution; asset base may limit funding additionality.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: Include campaigns, research, commercial/employer partnerships and investment-funded activity rather than marginal text cost alone.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: Trust for America's Health
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Defer: reports and budget advocacy have a longer unproven chain to effective services than selected implementation organizations.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Reports and briefings may not change budgets or effective services; public-health dollars are not direct charity outputs.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: Full research/advocacy portfolio includes broad preparedness and social determinants; allocation and additionality required.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: Vaccinate Your Family
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Defer: public persuasion may help, but professional implementation tools present a more actionable vaccination pathway to investigate first.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Information reach must lead to additional completed vaccination; persuasion effects and backfire need testing.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: Include all education, campaigns, program administration and advocacy; vaccine efficacy is not organization effectiveness.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: Immunize.org
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Prioritize clinical vaccination practice support with potentially low-cost repeated use; prove changed timely vaccination, not downloads.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Tools downloaded or professionals reached do not establish additional timely vaccination.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: Whole nonprofit resources and professional education; Immunize.org/IAC legacy naming needs legal-recipient confirmation, not a second row.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: Safe Kids Worldwide
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Defer: useful injury interventions but global portfolio and local host attribution weaken national unrestricted-gift clarity.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Local hosts may fund most implementation; attribution and behavior persistence cannot be inferred from national injury trends.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: Worldwide organization's unrestricted gift includes international work and national coordination; member-host costs must be reconciled.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: Safe States Alliance
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Defer: association conferences and professional development are farther from injury reductions; gift route also needs confirmation.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Membership/training outcomes may not translate into reduced injuries; ordinary gift route and marginal funding need checking.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: Whole association includes conferences, professional development and member support; do not use direct program delivery economics.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: Advocates for Highway and Auto Safety
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Real organization accepted for discovery. Defer comparative selection while ordinary charitable payee and incremental gift route remain unverified; missing donor readiness is not a discovery hold.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Counterfactual automaker/regulator action, compliance lag and coalition shares dominate.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: Include coalition operations and insurer-supported research; ordinary charitable donation eligibility/payee remains unverified.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: Mothers Against Drunk Driving
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Defer: technology policy upside is offset by regulatory counterfactuals and a broad survivor/education portfolio.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Projected future technology lives saved are not achieved MADD effects; regulation timing and industry attribution matter.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: Whole US organization includes survivor support and education; resolve Canadian entity/output treatment and separate foreign benefits.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: Sandy Hook Promise Foundation
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Defer: reported averted threats lack a defensible causal mortality basis and false-positive disciplinary harms matter.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Threat tips and asserted averted shootings are not causal mortality evidence; false positives and disciplinary harms matter.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: Foundation c3 only; include all education, research and support and avoid crediting the separate action organization.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: Everytown for Gun Safety Support Fund
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Defer: large policy upside but separate legal affiliates and coalition attribution complicate charitable-fund impact.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Policy correlation and advocacy scale do not establish this fund's marginal causal effect.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: Specific Support Fund recipient; exclude Action Fund political activity and avoid adding affiliates as independent candidates.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: Brady Center to Prevent Gun Violence
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Defer: c3/c4 gift-route distinction plus litigation and education attribution require cleanup before high-priority modeling.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Ad information seeking is not safe storage or lives saved; judge litigation counterfactuals and displacement.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: Brady Center c3 only; homepage default donation supports c4, so use explicitly charitable gift route and Center expenses.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: Roca
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Defer: serious high-risk population but intensive cost and weak conversion from arrest metrics to injuries lower expected research yield.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Observed retention/no-arrest results need valid controls; reincarceration is not injury and long intervention costs matter.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: Whole Roca includes young-men/women programs and systems work; property-holding affiliate is not another candidate.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: The Jed Foundation
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Alternate: institution-wide youth mental-health changes could persist across cohorts; treatment-capacity and causal suicide evidence remain gates.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: School participation and policy adoption are not suicide reductions; downstream clinical capacity may constrain impact.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: Whole JED includes community campaigns and resources as well as campus systems; use full gift allocation.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: Fountain House
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Defer: sustained severe-illness support is promising, but cost intensity and selection-confounded clubhouse evidence need stronger footing.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Clubhouse-member associations and before/after loneliness data need causal/duration checks; avoid counting national clubhouse effects as Fountain House's.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: Whole org includes direct clubhouse operations, research and wider systems work; other clubhouses are not subsidiaries by default.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: Treatment Advocacy Center
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Defer: possible severe-illness benefit is balanced by coercion harms and uncertain treatment-capacity effects.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Coercion, autonomy harms and confounding in AOT evaluations require explicit consideration; treatment capacity may remain missing.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: Include helpline, legal/policy advocacy and all education; do not equate an AOT law with treatment delivery.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: Mental Health America
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Defer: positive online screens are not additional effective treatment; broad portfolio adds substantial uncertainty.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Online positive screens do not prove treatment uptake or durable improvement; suicide effects not assumed.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: National recipient only; local affiliates' independent budgets/services cannot be fully credited to national gifts.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: National Alliance on Mental Illness
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Defer: peer and family support likely important, but whole national/affiliate scope and durable causal health effects are unresolved.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Awareness/support scale is not durable health effect; need causal evidence for actual programs and uptake.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: National NAMI only; do not count state/local affiliate delivery without explaining national gift's incremental contribution.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: The Headstrong Project
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Prioritize a direct trauma-treatment pathway with patient outcomes that can be checked; include dropout, relapse and available alternatives.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Completer-only symptom results can overstate effect; account for dropout, relapse, VA/private-care alternatives and therapist cost.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: Whole organization includes intake, clinical partnerships and ongoing sessions; no use of donated-session unit cost alone.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: Child Mind Institute
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Defer: care, global research and education portfolio makes unrestricted clinical subsidy additionality unclear.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Marginal donations may support global research or subsidize care patients would buy elsewhere; durable clinical benefit needed.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: Use whole institute's science, education and care portfolio; separately identify US benefits and any clinical-affiliate recipient.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: HealthWell Foundation
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Defer: expensive specialty-drug assistance may subsidize manufacturer pricing or substitute insurance without proportional health gain.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: US treatment location alone does not establish residency; expensive low-benefit medicines and manufacturer subsidy may undermine value.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: Whole foundation spans restricted disease funds and overhead; unrestricted gift allocation and payer substitution need examination.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: NeedyMeds
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Defer: navigation is potentially cheap but use and discounts are weak proxies for incremental adherence compared with actual pharmacy delivery.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Directory traffic/discount-card savings may produce little additional care; US-resident usage share not measured.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: Include all information, helpline and discount-card operations; verify earned revenue and underlying assistance providers' contribution.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: Rx Outreach
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Prioritize low-cost chronic medication access with an observable dispensing-to-adherence pathway; earned revenue and market alternatives must be reconciled.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Must show additional adherence rather than switching from similarly priced pharmacy options.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: Whole pharmacy funded partly by prescription revenue; use philanthropic marginal role and all operations, not retail-price savings.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: Remote Area Medical
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Prioritize tangible vision correction and dental pain relief using volunteer delivery; demand durability and follow-up rather than retail-value claims.
all100SelectionDispositions.mechanism: Mobile dental, vision and medical access
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Short episodic care may lack follow-up; volunteer and equipment contributions plus outside-care substitution matter.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: Whole-org mix across dental/vision/medical/telehealth, including logistics and fundraising, determines ordinary-gift effect.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: Family Reach
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Defer: financial distress and cancer support require stronger durable-health evidence than financial assistance totals.
all100SelectionDispositions.mechanism: Cancer financial navigation and basic needs
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Self-reported distress change may be transient; need treatment-adherence effect and proper counterfactual.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: Whole-org financial aid/navigation and fundraising; cash transferred is not itself QALYs and program restrictions matter.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: Colorectal Cancer Alliance
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Alternate: guideline-concordant screening with completed follow-up is plausible, but research/support mix and screening counterfactuals complicate whole gifts.
all100SelectionDispositions.mechanism: Colorectal cancer screening and care navigation
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Screening impressions/referrals are not completed screening; test yield, follow-up and overtreatment matter.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: Whole alliance now includes research/trial platforms, support and campaigns; evaluate all costs and US-benefit shares.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: National Breast Cancer Foundation
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Defer: screening benefit is limited by overdiagnosis and grant substitution; broader support portfolio further reduces clarity.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Overdiagnosis and false positives must be included; grant substitution and completed treatment determine value.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: Whole foundation includes education, navigation, relief and supportive programs; do not isolate best mammography grant.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: Children's Health Fund
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Defer: children face real access gaps, but national fund attribution and reimbursed partner services complicate marginal gifts.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Visits are not health outcomes; reimbursement substitution, partner contribution and full service costs may constrain value.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: National fund supports partner network and policy; avoid crediting full network output to unrestricted national donations.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: National Alliance to End Homelessness
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Defer: housing systems may generate health benefit, but housing placement is not automatically a clinical improvement.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Housing placement is not automatic health improvement; causal health evidence and additional policy influence needed.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: Whole national research/advocacy/training organization, not direct housing provider; include public housing resources and partner roles appropriately.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: RESULTS Educational Fund
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Defer: international and broad anti-poverty policy mix dilutes domestic health attribution.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Large global portfolio and diffuse political contribution may leave insufficient attributable US health impact.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: RESULTS Educational Fund charitable recipient; do not mix RESULTS action entity or assign overseas global-health effects to US benefit.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: Cribs for Kids
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Prioritize an actionable material safe-sleep barrier rather than awareness alone; actual sustained crib use is decisive.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Reject if provision does not change sleep practices or merely replaces cribs families would otherwise obtain.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: Unrestricted gifts support education, distribution and central operations; net out product revenue and partner-funded activity.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: First Candle
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Defer: training and bereavement mix provides a less direct prevention pathway than safe-sleep equipment plus support.
all100SelectionDispositions.mechanism: Caregiver and clinician safe-sleep behavior change.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Reject if training reach does not translate into sustained safer sleep or attributable mortality reduction.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: Whole portfolio includes bereavement, which needs separate valuation from prevention.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: Charlie's Kids Foundation
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Defer: inexpensive books are attractive but order pause and behavior-change uncertainty lower priority than physical safe-sleep provision.
all100SelectionDispositions.mechanism: Books, videos and clinician reinforcement of safe infant sleep.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Reject if books add no behavior change over standard advice; current temporary book-order pause limits delivery.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: Whole foundation includes educational materials and distribution; marginal printing and distribution capacity must be checked.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: National Drowning Prevention Alliance
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Defer: national coordination and layered-safety messaging do not yet establish implemented barriers; evidence is search-only.
all100SelectionDispositions.mechanism: Layered drowning prevention through barriers, education and systems coordination.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Reject if donations fund meetings and awareness without additional implementation of effective safeguards.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: Whole alliance coordination portfolio; do not credit all coalition or national drowning outcomes.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: USA Swimming Foundation
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Defer: elite-athlete and competitive-swimming support materially dilutes unrestricted drowning-prevention gifts.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Reject if lessons primarily serve already-safe swimmers or lack transfer to real-world drowning risk.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: Unrestricted portfolio also supports elite athletes and competitive swimming, potentially a major health-impact dilution.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: Stop Drowning Now
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Defer: school water-safety education is not equivalent to effective swim instruction or physical barriers.
all100SelectionDispositions.mechanism: Water-safety curriculum, assemblies and educational materials.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Reject if educational knowledge fails to change behavior; swim-lesson evidence cannot be assigned to an education-only program.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: Gift funds curriculum, outreach and administration, not necessarily physical barriers or swimming instruction.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: Institute for Safer Trucking
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Prioritize focused truck-safety regulation and fleet effects; implementation timing and independent manufacturer progress may defeat hypothesis.
all100SelectionDispositions.mechanism: Federal vehicle and operating safety policy.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Reject if rules would occur without the organization or advocated measures fail implementation or safety tests.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: Whole research, coalition and advocacy operation; allocate attribution among partners.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: National Safety Council
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Defer: extensive paid training and broad safety operations leave philanthropic increment difficult to establish.
all100SelectionDispositions.mechanism: Workplace and road injury prevention training and standards.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Reject if paid training is nonadditional or does not change injury rates.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: Substantial earned-revenue training and international activity require whole-organization and US-share analysis.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: Green Science Policy Institute
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Alternate: chemical-class policy leverage is promising, but global purchasing and uncertain clinical translation trail clearer implementation leads.
all100SelectionDispositions.mechanism: Research and purchasing or regulatory shifts away from harmful chemical classes.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Reject if safer substitutes are not safer or attributable exposure reductions lack demonstrated health relevance.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: Research and global purchasing influence require a US-resident allocation and coalition attribution.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: Toxic-Free Future
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Prioritize enforceable product and retailer reforms with identified US implementation work; avoid optimistic chemical-substitution assumptions.
all100SelectionDispositions.mechanism: Chemical research, state policy and retailer reform.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Reject if policy wins lack incremental implementation, exposure reduction or safer substitutes.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: Whole national research and advocacy portfolio; do not count allied campaigns as independently additional.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: Center for Environmental Health
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Prioritize product enforcement and purchasing changes capable of reaching many people; require actual exposure reduction rather than labels.
all100SelectionDispositions.mechanism: Legal, regulatory and purchasing pressure on hazardous products.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Reject if litigation changes labels only or exposure-health links are weak.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: Whole legal, research and purchasing portfolio; account for fee and settlement funding.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: Clean Air Council
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Defer: regional pollution litigation is plausible, but available packet gives less specific implementation leverage than selected environmental leads.
all100SelectionDispositions.mechanism: Regional air-pollution litigation, policy and transportation reform.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Reject if cases do not alter emissions or merely replace government enforcement.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: Whole regional advocacy portfolio includes benefits outside health; do not count those as QALYs.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: WE ACT for Environmental Justice
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Defer: focused community exposure risk is compelling, but energy and organizing portfolio makes health increment less clear.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Reject if organizing or energy referrals do not lead to measurable health-relevant exposure changes.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: Unrestricted support covers organizing, energy, research and policy; utility savings are not automatically health benefits.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: Clean Water Fund
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Defer: broad multi-state grassroots environmental portfolio and c3/c4 linkage need more attribution work than selected focused mechanisms.
all100SelectionDispositions.mechanism: Community water, air and toxic-exposure protections.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Reject if additional donations cannot influence enforceable pollution reductions.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: Clean Water Fund is the charitable recipient; distinguish complementary Clean Water Action activity and finances.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: Farmworker Justice
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Prioritize highly exposed farmworkers and occupational-health enforcement; unrestricted labor-rights share must be separated from clinical benefit.
all100SelectionDispositions.mechanism: Occupational health protections and healthcare access for agricultural workers.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Reject if health protections are not enforced or improvements would occur without this organization.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: Whole labor, immigration and health portfolio; economic and legal benefits need separate treatment.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: Migrant Clinicians Network
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Remains accepted for discovery but moves behind SIRUM: cross-border care continuity complicates domestic health allocation, whereas SIRUM's described delivery is explicitly through US partners. This is a qualitative research-order judgment, not established cost-effectiveness.
all100SelectionDispositions.mechanism: Maintain continuity of TB, pregnancy and chronic-disease care during migration.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Reject if coordination does not increase completed effective treatment versus existing systems.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: Whole training and care-coordination organization is international; count only US-resident benefits.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: National Center for Farmworker Health
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Defer: health-center technical assistance and referrals are further from additional care than selected implementation pathways.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Reject if referrals do not result in care or technical assistance duplicates existing public support.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: Whole training, data and navigation portfolio; member health-center outputs are not all attributable.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: Reproductive Health Access Project
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Alternate: clinician-based reproductive care expansion is concrete, but uptake and whole training/advocacy effectiveness are less established than Upstream.
all100SelectionDispositions.mechanism: Clinician training, fellowships and practice support.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Reject if trained clinicians do not offer additional care or patient health outcomes do not improve.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: Whole organization includes organizing and advocacy; network is a program, not a separate recipient.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: National Family Planning and Reproductive Health Association
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Alternate: Title X service capacity offers substantial leverage; need current actionable policy contribution and clinical follow-through.
all100SelectionDispositions.mechanism: Protect and improve publicly funded reproductive-health service capacity.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Reject if legislative work is nonadditional or additional funding cannot translate into effective care.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: Whole membership, advocacy and technical-assistance portfolio; avoid crediting all member clinical outcomes.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: National Institute for Reproductive Health
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Defer: state policy partnerships overlap selected reproductive-health systems mechanisms with a less direct clinical pathway.
all100SelectionDispositions.mechanism: State and local policy assistance and partner support.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Reject if policies do not change usable access or attributable patient health.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: Use charitable institute, not electoral Action Fund; whole portfolio includes policy and partnerships.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: Medicines360
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Defer: research, commercial product revenue and international subsidiary make the marginal unrestricted donation role difficult to establish.
all100SelectionDispositions.mechanism: Affordable contraceptive product development and delivery.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Reject if existing commercial or public options provide the same access without donations.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: Whole research and product-sales operation has international subsidiary Impact RH360; donation use and US share are unresolved.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: Dental Lifeline Network
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Prioritize comprehensive volunteer dental care for medically vulnerable patients; evaluate durable pain/function benefits and fully cost coordination.
all100SelectionDispositions.mechanism: Coordinate donated dental treatment, including medically necessary clearance.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Reject if volunteer care displaces other care, benefits are short-lived or medical clearance would occur anyway.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: Whole coordinating organization; do not treat donated retail prices or entire subsequent medical benefits as attributable.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: America's Dentists Care Foundation
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Defer: infrastructure can unlock care, but a second attribution layer over local dental clinics makes national marginal contribution less clear.
all100SelectionDispositions.mechanism: Shared infrastructure for volunteer dental treatment.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Reject if clinics would operate without this support or provide only transient benefit.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: Whole logistics and equipment recipient, not every local Mission of Mercy clinic; avoid partner double counting.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: Help America Hear
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Prioritize substantial hearing impairment with professionally fitted devices; patient testing, travel, fees and sustained use constrain real access.
all100SelectionDispositions.mechanism: Last-resort hearing-aid access with professional fitting.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Reject if devices go unused or affordable alternatives would meet the same need.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: Whole organization also funds scholarships; include fitting, follow-up and patient costs rather than donated list values.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: National Association of Free and Charitable Clinics
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Defer: national network support is plausible but cannot claim all member-clinic care and adds an attribution layer.
all100SelectionDispositions.mechanism: Clinic funding, standards, technical assistance and policy.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Reject if grants and assistance do not create additional effective treatment.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: Whole national organization is not its member clinics; Volunteers in Medicine is already a program here.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: American Academy of Family Physicians Foundation
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Defer: selected free-clinic equipment grants cannot represent the Foundation's unrestricted education, research and humanitarian portfolio.
all100SelectionDispositions.mechanism: Seed clinical infrastructure and volunteer primary-care capacity.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Reject if clinics would open anyway or expanded visits do not provide effective care.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: Unrestricted Foundation gifts also support broader education, research and humanitarian work; program-only economics are insufficient.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: Direct Relief
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Defer: international allocation and donated supply valuation obscure marginal US patient benefit.
all100SelectionDispositions.mechanism: Medicine and supply distribution to safety-net providers.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Reject if shipments replace normal purchasing, expire or do not reach patients needing treatment.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: Large global portfolio; use actual delivery and adherence, not wholesale donated-goods value, and isolate US share.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: Dispensary of Hope
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Accepted operating entity is Dispensary of Hope, LLC, EIN20-8973035, confirmed by final audit. Defer selection because a realistic unrestricted cash-gift route and Ascension parent fungibility remain unclear; no longer an operating-entity discovery hold.
all100SelectionDispositions.mechanism: Redistribute manufacturer-donated medicines through safety-net dispensing sites.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Reject if sites substitute existing supply or treatment adherence does not improve.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: Evaluate verified operating LLC, not an assumed unrestricted donation to all Ascension. Cash-gift eligibility and parent/subsidiary substitution remain to be established.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: Project Access NOW
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Defer: Oregon care access is concrete but navigation, discharge and premium supports need case-mix and substitution analysis.
all100SelectionDispositions.mechanism: Navigation and financing support connecting uninsured residents with care.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Reject if coverage paperwork does not lead to additional care or other assistance would pay.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: Whole Oregon organization includes discharge and social supports; not Patient Access Network or Washington's Project Access Northwest.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: Project Access Northwest
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Defer: specialty-care access is plausible but current geography and operations need stronger evidence beyond historical search-returned reports.
all100SelectionDispositions.mechanism: Coordinate donated specialty care and insurance assistance.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Reject if historical service geography is no longer current or care merely displaces hospital charity.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: Whole Washington organization; contemporary caseload and financial boundaries need review, distinct from Oregon Project Access NOW.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: Surgery on Sunday
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Prioritize essential volunteer outpatient surgery with potentially sustained functional gains; procedure mix, complications and charity-care alternatives are decisive.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Reject if case mix is low-benefit, complications offset gains or hospital charity would provide equivalent care.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: Whole Lexington nonprofit; distinguish the similarly named Louisville organization and include volunteer opportunity costs.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: US Alcohol Policy Alliance
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Prioritize population alcohol-policy implementation, a distinct prevention mechanism; failed or nonadditional policy adoption can erase upside.
all100SelectionDispositions.mechanism: Evidence-oriented alcohol policy capacity and advocacy.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Reject if supported policies are not adopted, lack enforcement or are not causally additional.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: Whole policy and coalition operation; attribute only its incremental contribution, not every supported policy outcome.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: Postpartum Support International
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Defer: peer support and training have plausible mental-health benefits, but international and conference portfolio dilutes whole-gift clarity.
all100SelectionDispositions.mechanism: Peer support, clinical training and treatment linkage.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Reject if contacts and training do not improve access to effective treatment and sustained recovery.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: International whole portfolio includes conferences and education; isolate US benefit and transferred programs.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: Maternal Mental Health Leadership Alliance
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Defer: policy alliance's contribution to actual care delivery is unproven; hotline promotion cannot count as operating the hotline.
all100SelectionDispositions.mechanism: Policy, education and systems coordination for perinatal mental-health care.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Reject if advocacy has no attributable effect on service availability and patient outcomes.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: Whole alliance; promotion of the national hotline does not establish that it operates or caused all hotline benefits.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: Policy Center for Maternal Mental Health
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Defer: think-tank adoption pathway and transferred programs make historical output unsuitable for current unrestricted value.
all100SelectionDispositions.mechanism: Research and policy design for perinatal mental-health systems.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Reject if think-tank outputs are not adopted or clinical care remains inaccessible.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: Formerly 2020 Mom; Mom Congress became independent and Blue Dot moved to PSI, so do not credit transferred activity twice.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: Black Mamas Matter Alliance
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Defer: highly disadvantaged maternal population merits attention, but capacity building, convening and global scope have uncertain clinical conversion.
all100SelectionDispositions.mechanism: Provider capacity, maternal-health systems and policy.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Reject if training and advocacy do not translate into changed clinical practice or outcomes.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: Whole organization includes research, convening and global work; isolate US-resident benefit and partner attribution.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: Healthy Birth Day
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Defer: fetal-movement monitoring has unresolved causal benefit and intervention harms; fetal versus infant valuation also requires explicit agreement.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Reject if observed state trends are not causal or false alarms and additional interventions offset benefit; define fetal versus infant health valuation explicitly.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: Healthy Birth Day is the recipient, Count the Kicks its program; whole app, education and advocacy portfolio.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: Save Babies Through Screening Foundation
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Defer: near-universal newborn screening creates limited headroom; treatment follow-up rather than awareness is the likely binding gap.
all100SelectionDispositions.mechanism: Parent education and newborn-screening policy implementation.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Reject if near-universal routine screening leaves little headroom or effective follow-up treatment is unavailable.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: Whole education and advocacy organization; false positives and overdiagnosis matter, and national screening outcomes are not all attributable.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: Hepatitis B Foundation
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Alternate: targeted domestic hepatitis linkage could prevent severe liver disease; global research and coalition attribution reduce whole-gift clarity.
all100SelectionDispositions.mechanism: Vaccination, testing and linkage to hepatitis B care.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Reject if additional screening does not produce treatment, adherence or vaccination among people otherwise missed.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: Whole Foundation includes research and global work; Hep B United is a coalition, not an extra recipient, and affiliate boundaries require review.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: End Overdose
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: Selected after removing HBBF sponsor-scope hold: direct naloxone availability and trained witnesses provide a concrete severe-harm pathway missing from the prior shortlist. Prioritize testing targeting, supply substitution and causal rescue benefit.
all100SelectionDispositions.mechanism: Equip likely overdose witnesses with naloxone and response training, with targeted community distribution.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Kits and training may reach low-risk people, substitute publicly supplied naloxone, remain unused or arrive too late. Distribution and reported reversals cannot be treated as incremental deaths averted; survivor follow-up and competing mortality matter.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: Evaluate all national training, chapter support, outreach, digital education, awareness, fundraising and fulfillment costs. Include recipient shipping burdens and donated supply constraints; the store describes shipping charges and possible stock/fulfillment limits. Do not evaluate only free product acquisition.

all100SelectionDispositions.name: SIRUM
all100SelectionDispositions.reason: First alternate: explicit US medication redistribution and monetary-support route provide a promising operational pathway. Keep behind selected direct care for now because adherence, donated inventory additionality and partner/Good Pill cost allocation remain unmodeled.
all100SelectionDispositions.mechanism: Technology, logistics and policy facilitate safe surplus-medicine redistribution to underserved patients through dispensing partners.
all100SelectionDispositions.keyFalsifier: Reject the health-leverage hypothesis if medicines mainly replace purchases or other aid, do not match clinical need, are not taken consistently, or have insufficient remaining shelf life. Retail donated-value totals, advertised per-prescription logistics cost and prescription counts cannot stand in for whole-org causal health return.
all100SelectionDispositions.wholeGiftScope: Evaluate unrestricted SIRUM's full collection, matching, technology, policy and partner support, plus the financial relationship to Good Pill and dispensing partners. Include patient fees and partner costs; do not count all partner clinical output as SIRUM-caused or use only best-condition medicines.

decisiveChanges.change: Replace HAVI membership with End Overdose
decisiveChanges.reason: HAVI remains HRiA-sponsored initiative scope hold. End Overdose is an identifiable national nonprofit with primary-source US naloxone distribution. Existing CA/global identity reused, not a new global entity.
HBBF remains Virginia Organizing sponsor-scope hold. SIRUM has an identifiable nonprofit tax history, explicit monetary support and US medication-distribution operations.

decisiveChanges.change: Remove HBBF from top25; add End Overdose
decisiveChanges.reason: Only discovery-accepted organizations enter selected research cohort. The replacement adds direct overdose prevention, not an assumed equivalence with environmental-health policy.

decisiveChanges.change: SIRUM enters alternate1; Migrant Clinicians Network becomes deferred
decisiveChanges.reason: Operational US medication pathway offers a clearer domestic allocation hypothesis than cross-border care continuity. Neither comparative return is established.

decisiveChanges.change: Dispensary of Hope identity hold removed at discovery; selection remains deferred
decisiveChanges.reason: Final audit resolves Dispensary of Hope, LLC and Ascension membership. Ordinary gift route and parent fungibility remain valid selection-level concerns, not reasons to erase accepted discovery.

decisiveChanges.change: PAF/PAN and Advocates stay in D100 despite comparative deferral
decisiveChanges.reason: Their financial or donor-route questions do not invalidate real-organization discovery acceptance.

provenance.timingMethod: Actual focused organization intervals include source retrieval, reading, reasoning and drafting through org switch. No retroactive allocation of gaps. Cohort comparison/integration synthesis is untimed and not apportioned.
provenance.olderTiming: Prior artifacts' retrieval-only partial timings are preserved without relabeling as full research.
